description: A contemporary luxury residential gate and perimeter wall setting photographed at night. Three tall square pillar caps in smooth cream or light buff stone are evenly spaced across the mid-ground, each topped with a cylindrical post-cap that glows with warm amber light from horizontal bands between metal banding rings with a circular emblem detail, casting a warm upward and downward glow on the pillar faces. Between the pillars, horizontal slatted metal screen panels in dark anthracite alternate with a solid wooden vertical-slat privacy screen in warm brown timber on the far right edge. A dark grey large-format stone panel facade of the building is visible in the background, with a covered overhang where warm amber concealed lighting illuminates a deep soffit band above a glazed entry door. A bare-branched ornamental tree is silhouetted at the upper left. Low clipped boxwood hedging grows at the base of the wall on the left. The sky is deep charcoal-blue at night. The atmosphere is sleek, formal, and upscale East Asian-influenced contemporary. Camera is at standing eye-level, centered and level, wide establishing view capturing all three pillars, the gate passage in the center, and the building entry behind.
